reddit.title: Exciting Updates in Provincia: Multilingual Support and Improved Placement Feedback
reddit.body: We're thrilled to announce that our build UI now supports ten languages, enhancing accessibility for our players. Additionally, we've improved placement feedback so you can easily understand why a placement might fail. Plus, our day/night transitions are now smoother, ensuring your colony runs seamlessly as the sky changes. Dive into the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ten-locales-clearer-placement?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ten-locales-clearer-placement

steam.title: Provincia Update: New Languages and Enhanced Feedback
steam.body: We're excited to announce that Provincia's build UI now supports ten languages, making it more accessible for players worldwide. Additionally, we've improved placement feedback to help you understand why certain placements may fail. Enjoy smoother day/night transitions for a more seamless gameplay experience. Read more about these updates here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ten-locales-clearer-placement?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ten-locales-clearer-placement
